subject: Re: Redwood POC kickoff — next steps / runbook
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeanalytics.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Redwood POC kickoff — next steps / runbook

Hi Alex / Sanjay,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood performance and cost for your customer-facing summarization pipeline (target: 10k daily active users in Q3).
- Success criteria: 
  - Latency: 95th p95 < 450ms for typical 512-token requests
  - Cost: target $0.003 / 1k tokens (after batching/quantization)
  - Integration: example transformer in staging pipeline that hits Redwood via SDK

Proposed next steps: 
1) POC kickoff meeting — schedule for next week to walk through runbook and access (we suggested Tue/Wed).
2) Access: I’ll send a temporary dedicated trial workspace and a short runbook (credentials, sample prompt set, and test harness).
3) Instrumentation: Rafael will share a minimal telemetry checklist for latency/cost measurement.

We’ll attach the POC runbook and a draft SOW for scope — these are lightweight and editable. Rafael and I will be on the kickoff to help with onboarding and to unblock infra.

Can you confirm preferred kickoff day/time (your timezone) and whether you want us to include an SRE or engineering lead on the call?

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Redwood_POC_Runbook_v1.pdf, SOW_Acme_Redwood_draft.docx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood POC kickoff — next steps / runbook

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear summary. Tue at 10am PT works for us for the kickoff.

Two quick asks before the call: 
- Can you send the runbook so our infra lead can pre-read?
- Any recommended test dataset or prompt set we should prepare (we’ll aim to mirror a 512-token median request).

I’ll invite our SRE, Sanjay, to the kickoff. Looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Alex

Subject: Re: Redwood POC kickoff — checking in

Hi Alex —

Just bumping this thread to see if Tue at 10am PT is still good and whether you had a chance to review the runbook. Rafael and I are standing by to kick off.

If priorities shifted on your side, totally understandable — could you let me know whether this is still a priority for Q2? If timing changed, we can reschedule or pare down the initial scope to a quick smoke test instead.

Short options: 
- Proceed with Tue 10am PT kickoff (we’ll send a calendar invite + temporary trial workspace).
- Push to a later week (please share a couple windows).
- Do a lightweight smoke test: 1-hour session focused on getting SDK calls and a perf sample.

Thanks — no pressure, just want to make sure we’re aligned and not blocking your team.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Final follow-up — Redwood POC kickoff / help with setup?

Hi Alex / Sanjay —

I haven’t heard back about the kickoff — wanted to check in one last time this week. We’ve got the temporary workspace and runbook ready; attaching the latest runbook and the draft SOW in case it helps move things forward. 

If the POC is no longer a priority, let me know and I’ll close this out on our side. If you still want to proceed but need a lighter touch, we can: 
- Run a 45-minute smoke test that only validates SDK connectivity + a single perf measurement, or
- Provide a short recorded walkthrough of the runbook and a one-click test harness you can run asynchronously.

Would you prefer one of these options? If I don’t hear back by EOD next Tue I’ll assume you want to pause and I’ll follow up later.

Thanks — appreciate the time.

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
